features: 1080p HD, true day/night (switched mechanical IR filter)
Automatic varifocal (AVF) 3-10 mm lens with motorized zoom/focus and lens wizard
Built-in active IR illuminator, 10 LED 850 nm, up to 15 m, adjustable intensity
76 dB WDR, Intelligent Defog, Intelligent Dynamic Noise Reduction
Quad streaming H.264 + M-JPEG, regions of interest / E-PTZ
Analog CVBS video out (SMB), 1 alarm in / 1 alarm out, audio line in/out
IP66 / NEMA Type 4X, IK10 vandal-resistant housing

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDN(I)_5000_Data_sheet_enUS_19048259339.pdf, V18 Jan 2021). NDI = version with active infrared illuminator (15 m). A3 = automatic varifocal 3-10 mm lens generation (distinct from the earlier -V3 models). Sensitivity colour 0.24 lx / mono 0.05 lx at 30 IRE. Weight 1102 g is given for the family.
